welcome.title: Welcome to the Translation Studio
welcome.descStart: Help us localize the Xernerx platform directly within the app! You are translating from our source of truth,
welcome.newEntriesDesc: Tackle missing keys one by one through a distraction-free card interface. Go at your own pace without feeling overwhelmed.
welcome.reviewDesc: Need to fix a typo or refine a translation reported by users? Browse and update all existing translations in a full list.
welcome.footerPart1: Once you are finished translating, click
welcome.footerPart2: at the top right to submit your work to the review branch! Any untranslated or empty entries will be omitted automatically.

guide.title: Before you start
guide.step1: If possible you may require a basic understanding of the English (UK) language
guide.step2: You can choose to either review new entries or modify existing ones
guide.step3: There is no deadline or haste upon these translations, take your time.
guide.step4: When you are changing keys the push to review button will become available, only press this once ready.
guide.step5: While editing try to not close or refresh the page, it may lose unsaved progression.
guide.step6: After submitting you will see your translated keys untranslated again, this is normal. The live environment cannot update manually, you have to wait for an admin to merge this updated dictionary with the live environment. You can speed up this progress by asking an admin directly to merge these changes

card.title: What are environments?
card.description: Within Xernerx Studios we speak of 3 environments: release (production), canary (beta) and dev (development). Here is what each of them mean:

release.label: Release
release.description: The stable production environment used for general release.

canary.label: Canary
canary.description: The beta environment used for pre-release testing of new features.

dev.label: Dev
dev.description: The development environment used for active building and testing.

card1.title: How do I become a translator?
card1.p1: You can apply directly from the Language preferences page if a language has less than 100% coverage.
card1.p2: Make sure you are logged in and on the account page.

card2.title: How long does it take for an application to be reviewed?
card2.description: Whenever an admin has time to review your submission and merge the translations with the live environment

card3.title: I translated but it didn't update?
card3.description: Translations cannot be automatically applied, the web page needs to be rebuild. Whenever you submit a review we get a notification asking to apply the newly added translations, we will allow this once reviewed.

card4.title: My language is not included in the list, how can I add it?
card4.description: For now you are required to request the language in our support channels, a language base will be created and then you can start translating for us!
